newsitem.title: GERMANY: German coffee roaster Tchibo to buy competitor.
newsitem.headline: German coffee roaster Tchibo to buy competitor.

text.p: Tchibo Holding AG will buy Eduscho GmbH & Co. KG with effect from January 1, a statement from Bremen-based Eduscho said on Wednesday.
Approval had been sought from the monopoly authorities, it added.
Both companies, which offer coffee and consumer goods in tied outlets, would continue to operate as separate corporate entities.
They planned to use their combined strength in Germany, Austria and other selected European markets to the maximum benefit of the consumer in product quality and service.
